map.双倍余额递减折旧：年折旧率 = 2 ÷ 使用年限 n；第 k 年折旧 = 期初账: Double-declining balance depreciation: annual depreciation rate = 2 ÷ useful life n; year k depreciation = opening book value × (2÷n), charged against the declining book value each year; in the final year (k = n), or when charging would push book value below the residual value, depreciation is closed out as book value − residual value (residual-value fallback) so the closing book value is never below the residual value. Validation: useful life must be positive, and the year number must be an integer between 1 and 1000, otherwise an error is reported. Rule: no fixed grading; the output gives the year-y depreciation, closing book value and accumulated depreciation (CNY), with heavier depreciation early and declining each year.
